explanation: Changing the editable-install check from 'lightning' to 'lightning-app' (with a hyphen) means the egg-info directory looked up is 'lightning-app.egg-info', but Python packaging typically uses underscores or the original project name format, so this rename may never match an actual egg-info directory, causing the function to always return empty and silently skip wheel packaging for editable installs.
